risk_if_not_implemented: Without Novel Risk Assessment Methods & Technologies, risks may remain unidentified, unowned or unmanaged, leaving decision-makers without a defensible basis for prioritization and treatment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Incident Response Plan (IRP)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain and make available a current and viable Incident Response Plan (IRP) to all stakeholders.
compensating_control_1.justification: Incident Response Plan (IRP) (IRO-08) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Novel Risk Assessment Methods & Technologies (AAT-12.1) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Novel Risk Assessment Methods & Technologies (AAT-12.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
